blocks.x: Your name is Hall, my wife. Sometimes it changes. Yeah, chances of greening the Hall. Well everybody in the band had nicknames. We talked about it. All we asked was you, man. Yeah.
I was telling Dick the other day, I don't know if you remember what the office nickname was. Shook. Shook, yeah. You didn't remember that?
Great, you know, I have to... It was one minute.
And, Henry Turner was called Nick. Nick, Nick, Nick, Nick. Nick, Nick, Nick. Nick, Nick, Nick, Nick. Nick, Nick, Nick, Nick. Nick, Nick, Nick, Nick. Nick, Nick, Nick, Nick.

Nick, Nick, Nick, Nick. And, uh, Al Freeman? I wish you could hear him after that Jew, I used to do a selfie stuff. But, uh, I can't call his name, I was just telling him, uh, but we used to just call him Freeman.
Where was the, where did he, this is a hot shop you're talking about? I don't know much, yeah. Sunset.
